title: IMT Mixer
text: Model mixer using intermodulation table (IMT), {Frequencies (Hz)} sets Frequency data; {Carrier frequency (Hz)}, {Local oscillator frequency (Hz)}, {Reference input power (dBm)}, {Nominal output power (dbm)}, {Use data file}, {Data file}, {Input impedance (Ohm)}, {Output impedance (Ohm)}, {Ground and hide negative terminals}, {IMT table} sets the iMT spur visualization {Output signal power (dBm)} sets the signal power of desired output tone, {Mixer type}, {Plot} sets the visualize IMT table values using specified signal power and mixer type, {Simulate noise} sets the simulate device or phase noise, {Noise type}, {Noise distribution}, {Noise figure (dB)}, {Minimum noise figure (dB)}, {Optimal reflection coefficient}, {Equivalent normalized noise resistance}, {Add LO phase noise} adds phase noise, {Phase noise frequency offset (Hz)}, {Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)} sets the phase noise level, {Automatically estimate impulse response duration} and {Impulse response duration}.
